plugins.description: DSH plugin: inline each image block only in the request where it first appears, then swap it for the harness's own placeholder text
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-once 中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.1-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/senyayume/dsh-image-once?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/senyayume/dsh-image-once/stargazers) 「图片只发一次」：对话里的每个图片块**只在它出现的那一次请求**里以 base64 内联，之后的请求换成 DSH 自带的占位文字（占位文字里带本地只读路径，模型要看时自己 `read_image`）。 [它长什么样](#它长什么样) · [为什么](#为什么) · [做什么](#做什么) · [配置](#配置可选) · [客户端半体](#客户端半体) · [代价](#代价) · [装配](#装配) ## 它长什么样 **设置 → 插件**，找到 `dsh-image-once` 那一行（行右侧开关控制整个插件是否生效）： ![插件页上的插件行与「配置」入口](assets/plugin-row.png) 点该行的「配置」进入本插件页面，就是一张 provider 名单：每行一个开关，关掉即该 provider 完全不进本插件； 行右侧「限定模型」可以把这个 provider 收窄到几个模型 id。改完即时生效、不用重启。 ![插件页上的 provider 名单卡片](assets/provider-list.png) 上面两张都是**本机实机截图**（亮色主题，DSH Desktop 自带 harness）。卡片里那几行 provider 是本机装了 哪些 provider 就是哪些——**本插件不认识任何 provider 名**，它只是把宿主注册表里的名字原样列出来。 ## 为什么 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 会把对话里**每个未 offload 的图片出现**在**每一次请求**里重新 base64 内联。于是一旦贴过几张截图，整轮对话的每个 step 都在背几 MB 的请求体。 实测（commandcode，同一张图）： | 请求体 | 首字节 | |---|---| | 49B（纯文本）| 2.5s | | 350KB | 4.7s | | 1.36MB | 9-11s | | 4.10MB（12 张小图）| 25.7-27.6s | | 4.38MB（1 张大 PNG）| 23.5-26.3s | 同尺寸 body 在 deepseek 官方 / workbuddy 上只要 1-3.5s。原始 TLS 分腿测出 4.38MB **上传**只花 231ms、首字节 33.2s —— 慢在网关侧 ingest，与我们上行无关。 ## 做什么 每个「图片出现」= `sessionId + message.id + 内容树路径 + attachmentId`： - 第一次见到 → 原样内联（保证模型第一次看全），**该请求产出第一个 chunk 后**才记账（失败/重试不算已发）； - 之后任何请求 → 该出现标 `offloaded: true`，DSH 自带逻辑把它换成带本地只读路径的占位文字； - 模型 `read_image` 重看 = 新出现 → 再内联一次； - 带 `purpose` 的辅助请求（会话标题、摘要）不改写、不记账； - 记账只在内存、只影响本次请求的副本，**不写回会话**；`offloaded` 是共享合同字段（DSH 自己的图片压缩流程也用它）。 ### 图片的两种形状，都处理 `read_image` 的返回在**不同 DSH 版本里形状不同**，插件必须都认（否则会静默失效：图片每请求重新内联，却不报任何错）： | 形状 | 出自 | 结构 | |---|---|---| | **扁平** | `app.asar` 内置 dsh 的 `createToolResultMessage` | `{ role: "tool", content: [text, image] }` | | **嵌套** | profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 message 构造 | `{ role: "user", content: [{ type: "tool-result", content: [text, image] }] }` | 插件的扫描与改写**递归进 `tool-result`**，与 DSH 自己 `contentHasImage` 的口径一致。判定用 `sessionId + message.id + 路径 + attachmentId`：顶层路径是纯数字（`"3"`）、嵌套是点分（`"3.1"`），所以升级不会让已记账的顶层图片重发一次。 改写是**逐块重建**：未改动的块（含图片之后的文本、`tool-result` 外壳）原样保留。 ## 两个已修的缺陷 都由 `test/host.mjs` 的用例钉住，且**都先验证过「旧代码会失败」**（不是先写测试再让它过）： 1. **丢块** —— 旧实现以 `content.slice(0, index)` 起手、循环里只 push 图片块，于是第一张图**之后**的块全部从请求里静默消失： | 原消息 | 旧实现实际发出 | |---|---| | `[text:A, image, text:B]` | `text:A image(offloaded)` —— **丢 text:B** | | `[image, text:"说明"]` | `image(offloaded)` —— **丢整段说明** | 2. **漏嵌套** —— 旧实现只看 `message.content` 顶层，`tool-result` 里的图片完全看不见（`read_image` 结果在嵌套版本上每请求重发）。 判据不是读注释：先用运行面的真实形状把两个缺陷复现成数据，再改，再让同一组用例由红转绿。 ## 配置（可选） **设置 → 插件 → `dsh-image-once` 那一行 → 「配置」**，就是一张 provider 名单：每行一个开关，关掉即该 provider 完全不进本插件。也可以给某个 provider 限定模型（行右侧「限定模型」）。 缺省**对所有 provider、所有模型**生效；关掉某些行 = 只收窄那些 provider。 ```yaml # 界面上改的就是这一段，也可以直接手写在同一位置 - id: image-once config: providers: <适配器注册名>: enabled: false # 该 provider 完全不进本插件 models: [deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash] # 只对这些模型生效；空数组 = 该 provider 全部模型 ``` 语义：**没出现过的 provider = 生效**；`providers` 为空 = 全部 provider 生效。provider 名匹配**适配器注册名**（宿主日志里 `已包裹 provider "commandcode"` 即此名，不是 displayName）；`models` 匹配 `options.model`，也就是模型 id。 改完**即时生效，不用重启**（配置是 volatile 的，本插件每次请求现读）。 ### 手写 YAML 的位置与边界 要手写就写 **profile 的补丁文件**（`~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`），它是对包自带那一行的**覆盖**（补丁层顺序 bundle → profile → home → CLI，后层覆盖前层，且 `config` 是**整块替换**而不是 merge）： ```yaml - id: image-once config: providers: commandcode: models: - deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash ``` > 这里**不要再写 `insert:`** —— 包自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 已经插入了 `id: image-once` 这一行，重复 id 会让插件安装的试启动校验回滚。 > 插件 config 由 cordis 作为 `apply(ctx, config)` 的**第二个参数**传入。不要写 `ctx.config`——未注入 `config` 服务的插件访问它会抛 `cannot get property "config" without inject`，宿主会把该 entry 记成 `did not activate`。 > 界面与 YAML 是同一份 stored config，只有一个真源；两边不要同时改。 ## 客户端半体 本包有 `dsh.client`（`platform: "web"`）+ `exports["./client"]`，因此浏览器里会加载 `lib/client.js`，在 `plugins.row.config` 槽上按 `key = dsh-image-once#image-once` 注册上面那张名单卡片。该 bundle 是**手写的平台闭包工厂**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`，只 `require("react")`，走平台 seed），**没有构建步骤**。 ### 配色契约：只用 DSH 自己的 token 卡片的样式表**不写任何颜色字面量**，全部走 `--dsw-alias-*` 角色 token（外加 `--dsw-radius-*`、`--dsw-focus-ring-*`、`--ds-font-family-code`），因此亮/暗主题各自成立、皮肤覆盖也跟着走。 这条规矩是被一次真实事故逼出来的：早先的样式表读的是 `--dsh-text` / `--dsh-border` / `--dsh-accent` / `--dsh-danger`——**这四个名字 DSH 从来没有定义过**（本机 `app.asar` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme` 里定义数为 0，扫描 31829 个文件同样为 0）。`var()` 引用了不存在的自定义属性时整条声明无效，于是 - 文字色回退到浏览器默认色（亮色主题下接近不可见）； - 开关/选中态用上了插件自己写的深色兜底值（蓝 `#4c8dff`、`rgba(120,170,255,.22)`）。 **判据（插件页那张截图）**：全部文字实测 `#e6e6e6`（正是 CSS 里写的兜底值），而同一页官方文字是 `#0f1115`；开关胶囊实测正好 `rgb(76,141,255)` = 兜底值 `#4c8dff` 的逐字节相等——不是"看起来像"，是字面值落地。 `test/client.mjs` 现在有一道门禁：抽取 bundle 真正注入的样式表，逐个 `var()` 名字比对**显式白名单**，并要求零颜色字面量。新增 token 前先确认它由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`（或 shipped `ui-primitives`）定义，再进白名单——写错名字会**测试失败**，不再静默渲染成错的颜色。 ## 代价 模型对每张图的「视觉记忆」只有内联那一次；之后它只知道这张图存在（sha256 / 尺寸 / 文件名 / 本地只读路径），要再看细节会自己 `read_image`，那次请求再内联一次。对「贴图看一眼然后文字讨论」几乎免费。 ## 装配 本地包形态（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `cordis.patch.yml`），用 `dsh plugin --profile add <本包目录|github:senyayume/dsh-image-once>` 安装，进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，插件页可见、可开关。 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies` 里必须保留 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`：宿主半体 `import z from "@deepseek-ai/schemastery"`，而本包在 profile 里是 linked 形态，bare specifier 只会在祖先目录的 `peerDependencies` 里被 `routeLinked` 拦到真实安装目录。 **改了 `lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` 或 `package.json` 后要整包重启 DSH Desktop**：宿主热重放补丁层时会复用 Node 的 ESM 模块缓存，`.mjs`/`.js` 的改动热更吃不到；`package.json` 的 `dsh.client`/`exports` 变更还要让 client-modules 重新扫描 roster。 ## 测试 ```sh node test/run.mjs ``` 两半都跑：`test/host.mjs`（请求投影、occurrence 记账键、两种图片形状、上面两个已修缺陷、首个 chunk 后才记账）与 `test/client.mjs`（token 白名单、零颜色字面量门禁、zh/en 键对齐）。`test/run.mjs` 需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 这个 dev peer，缺了会直接以 `missing dev peer at …` 停下，而不是当成通过。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件:工作区级任务记忆,把做过的任务存成记忆卡,下次会话不必重新分析一遍。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-memory

DeepSeek Harness 插件：**工作区级任务记忆**。

解决的问题：相似的活会反复出现，而每次会话都从零重新分析一遍。这个插件把"做过的任务"存成**一人一张**的记忆卡，并且让卡片以**两段式**被检索——先看索引，命中后才读那一张的正文，所以记忆再长也不需要每次全读。

## 两段式检索

| 阶段 | 机制 | 成本 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **索引** | 一张有界的卡片摘要清单，注入到会话（一行一卡：名字 + 描述 + 触发词） | 常驻，且按使用频率排序、有硬上限 |
| **正文** | 命中后用 `task_memory_load` 取那一张卡的正文 | 一次调用，只读一张 |

索引不进对话历史，也不按轮次重复；其余卡片用 `task_memory_index` / `task_memory_search` 发现。**记忆再长也不需要每次全读。**

上架过的卡片（见下）会额外出现在 Harness 的技能目录里，可以用内置 `skill` 工具加载——但那是可选的，不是索引机制本身。

## 数据布局

**所有工作区共用一个 SQLite 数据库**：`$DSH_HOME/task-memory/memory.db`（默认 `~/.dsh/task-memory/memory.db`）。表内用 `workspace` 列隔离各工作区。

```
meta     (key, value)                       ← schema 版本等
cards    (workspace, name, description, when_to_use, triggers, tags,
          status, published, revision, created, updated, body, hits, last_used)
assets   (workspace, card, path, bytes)     ← 外键级联，随卡片一起删除
```

用 `node:sqlite`（Node 内置）实现，**零第三方依赖、无需编译**。本机 `dsh-memento` 已在用同一机制，所以 Electron 宿主也支持。

数据库相对文件存储买到的三个性质：

| 性质 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **原子性** | 卡片与附件在同一事务里写入，崩溃不会留下"有附件没卡片" |
| **唯一身份** | 卡名是主键列，"一件事只留一张卡"是 schema 保证，不是靠代码反复检查 |
| **计数不漂移** | `hits`/`last_used` 是卡片行上的列，不可能与卡片失联 |

索引仍然**永远从行数据现算**，不存索引表；`## 变更记录` 段落承担版本历史，所以也不需要 journal。

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `task_memory_index` | 完整索引，可按 `query` / `status` / `tag` / `tier` 过滤。索引被上限截断时兜底 |
| `task_memory_load` | 按名字取一张卡的正文、元数据与附件清单 |
| `task_memory_asset` | 读取某张卡的某个附件（代码片段、补丁等，存于数据库） |
| `task_memory_save` | 落卡。默认 `auto` 模式会**拒绝为已记录的任务再建一张卡**，并返回候选卡 |
| `task_memory_search` | 跨卡片正文全文检索（带片段），触发词都没命中时兜底 |

## 新鲜度分档

记忆库有两种"旧"：**内容过时**（`status`: verified/draft/stale，人工判断）和**久未使用**（档位，自动按时间算）。两者正交——一张卡可以既"已确认"又"遗忘"（内容正确但一年没用了）。合成一个字段就再也说不清用户指的是哪种。

### 五档（天数可配置）

| 档位 | 默认距离 | 在注入索引里的呈现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **近期** | ≤ 7 天 | 名字 + 描述 + **触发词** + 年龄 + 使用次数 |
| **之前** | 8–30 天 | 同上 |
| **很久之前** | 31–90 天 | 名字 + 描述（**去掉触发词**）+ 年龄 |
| **远古** | 91–365 天 | **只有名字**，合并成一行 |
| **遗忘** | > 365 天 | **不列出**，只报一行数量 |

这就是"检索频率不同"：**越旧的卡越不容易出现在模型眼前，但一次也没丢**。

### 时间基准：`max(updated, lastUsed)`

- 刚**改写**过的卡 = 知识新鲜 → 算活跃
- 刚被**检索**过的卡 = 仍被需要 → 算活跃

取较新者。只用 `updated` 会让"写完再没碰过"的卡一直假装新鲜；只用 `lastUsed` 会把刚创建、还没被检索过的卡判成遗忘。两者都是 `cards` 表上的列，所以不可能与卡片失联。

### 遗忘 ≠ 删除

遗忘档只做三件事：不注入、面板可见并标记、**工具仍能检索到**。行数据一个字段都不动——一个会自己删记忆的记忆插件比一个拥挤的更糟。

想清理时用面板上的「清理遗忘」按钮：它先列出所有遗忘档卡片让你确认，再删除指定名字的那些。**没有自动清理**。

档位边界写进配置（`tierDays`），随时可改；改完不需要迁移任何数据，因为**档位永远是算出来的，不存进文件**。

## 筛选

面板顶部有两个筛选器：

| 控件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| **档位下拉** | 默认（按配置，通常只看近期）/ 全部档位 / 仅近期 / 仅之前 / 仅很久之前 / 仅远古 / 仅遗忘 |
| **起止日期** | 按最后活动日期过滤；范围默认**取真实数据的最早~最晚**，可改 |
| **日期条** | 每个「有卡片的日期」一个可点标签（显示月-日与张数），点一下就把范围收到那一天 |

日期条是必需的补充：原生 `<input type="date">` 的日历弹层同样由 Chromium 绘制、CSS 碰不到，而**用日期选择器排错时最关键的信息是"哪天有记忆"**。所以那个信息放在选择器旁边，而不是指望日历里能标出来。

档位筛选**在宿主侧执行**（不是浏览器里过滤）：列表本身有上限，本地过滤会把本该被查询捞出来的卡藏掉。

工具 `task_memory_index` 也接受 `tier` 参数，含义与面板一致。

## 设置页

「设置 → 任务记忆」区块，改完保存**立即生效**（不需要重启）：

| 设置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 面板默认显示哪些档位 | 打开面板时默认勾选的档位；默认只看近期 |
| 档位边界（天） | 四个边界，改完立刻影响分档 |
| 注入索引的卡片上限 | 索引里最多列多少张 |
| 单张卡正文上限 | 超出截断并给出数据库位置 |
| 回合结束自动落卡 | 关掉后只能由你明确要求才记录 |

**设置存在哪里**：`$DSH_HOME/task-memory/settings.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/task-memory/settings.json`）。

优先顺序是 **设置文件 > `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 config > 内置默认**。设置文件赢，因为它代表你最后一次在界面上做的选择；loader config 仍然是新安装的种子值。

**打开设置页会补齐缺失的参数。** 页面上每个参数都显示它的有效值，而一个"没有记录"的参数是无法在界面里改的——所以读取设置时会把本地文件缺的字段按**当前生效的值**写进去（不是写死默认值：通过 loader config 设过 `maxCatalogCards: 99` 的部署，文件里也该是 99，否则文件与运行中的插件说的不是一回事）。已经写过的值永远不会被覆盖。

为什么不用宿主自己的设置服务：`dsh-settings` 只渲染插件用 schemastery 声明了 `.volatile()` 字段的表单，而本插件**零依赖、没有 schema**。手写 YAML 去改 profile 的 patch 文件则有损坏整个 profile 启动配置的风险——为了一个设置面板不值得。所以设置写进自己的 JSON 文件，原子写（临时文件 + rename），坏文件退化成"没有覆盖"而不是启动失败。

## 兼容旧版记忆

早期版本把记忆存成 `<工作区>/.dsh/task-memory/notes/<卡名>/SKILL.md` 加一个 `stats.json`。那些文件里的知识仍然有效，所以面板上有一个「**兼容旧版记忆**」按钮，按当前选择的工作区把它搬进数据库。

点击后是**三步，每步都有确认**：

1. **预演**（不写任何东西）—— 告诉你将导入多少张、其中多少是新建、多少与库里已有卡片同名、多少附件、多少张无法解析。
2. **导入** —— 已存在的同名卡片**不会被覆盖**（导入永远不破坏库里更新的版本），然后报告实际写入了什么。
3. **删除旧文件** —— 这一步单独确认，且在导入成功之后才提出。

导入用 `importCard` 原样写回：原始日期、revision、hits、last_used 都保留，而不是当作新卡重新推导。删除只动 `notes/` 与 `stats.json` 两项，同目录下别的插件数据不会被碰。

## 自动落卡

**默认不需要你开口。** 每个回合结束时，如果这一轮确实做了实事（工具调用 ≥ 3 次）而且**还没有存过卡**，插件会自动追问模型一次：

> 任务记忆自动检查：本轮工作已结束。回顾本轮，判断是否产生了值得留存的东西……

模型据此判断本轮是否有非显然结论/踩坑/可复用流程：有就调 `task_memory_save`，没有就回一句"本轮无需记录"。

为什么要这么做：**一段提示词只能"请求"模型记录，而刚干完活的模型不会可靠地执行又一条指令**。之前的实测就是——你不主动说"记住这个"，卡片永远是零。所以这里用的是真实触发点而不是请求：宿主在关闭回合前会 await `agent/turn-stopping`，监听器调 `agent.steer(...)` 就能让机器多跑一步。

**为什么是"追问"而不是"直接写"**：只有模型分得清"可复用的根因"和"一次性的查询结果"。缺的不是判断力，而是**提醒自己去判断**这件事。

三个防呆：

| 条件 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 本轮工具调用 < 3 次 | 不提醒（查询、闲聊、小改动） |
| 本轮已经存过卡 | 不提醒（记忆已是最新） |
| 本轮本身就是提醒引发的复查 | 不提醒（**防死循环的关键**） |

模型说"不值得存"时不会硬写。关闭方式：把 `autoCapture` 设为 `false`。

## 上架与不上架

**卡片默认只留在本工作区的任务记忆里，不进技能目录。** 需要时用 `publish: true` 单独上架。

为什么默认不上架：本插件的卡片注册成 runtime 技能后，会出现在 Harness 的技能目录里，而技能中心（Skill Center）页面列的就是同一份目录。技能中心是给人挑通用技能的地方，不该被某个工作区的排查记录塞满。而且技能中心虽然能编辑技能，却**无法操作 runtime 条目**（它列出的 runtime 技能没有文件路径），所以这些卡片在那里只是一排点了没反应的噪声。

| 状态 | 出现在任务记忆索引 | 出现在技能目录/技能中心 | 加载方式 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 未上架（默认） | ✅ | ❌ | `task_memory_load` / `task_memory_search` |
| 已上架（`publish: true`） | ✅ | ✅ | 上面两种，外加内置 `skill` 工具 |

**上架与否不影响可检索性**：未上架的卡一样会被注入索引、一样能被工具检索和加载，只是不会污染面向人的技能列表。上架状态是**粘性**的——一次 `update` 不会把它悄悄取消，只有显式传 `publish: false` 才撤下。

判断标准：**跨任务复用的通用方法论**才值得上架；某个项目的排查记录、一次性结论留在工作区即可。

### 上架后立即生效，不用等

技能的收集结果在注册表里是**按 revision 缓存**的，所以"改了卡片"本身不会让目录刷新。本插件在**每次写入后主动调 `control.invalidate()`** —— 它把 revision 加一、清掉缓存并通知观察者，于是下一次收集必然重新读取。

关键在于宿主侧的消费方式：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill` 在**每一步**（`agent/pre-step`）都会 `snapshot()` 一次并比对摘要，摘要变了才推送新目录。所以 invalidate 之后的下一个步骤就会看到新卡片。

这对模型侧的技能列表是**立即**的。技能中心页面是浏览器里的列表，点一下刷新即可看到；它读的是同一份已失效的缓存，不会再拿到旧数据。

## 只记一份

`task_memory_save` 的三种模式：

- `auto`（默认）：先用本地相似度（字符 trigram + 触发词重合 + 标签重合）比对已有卡片。判定为同一件事时**不创建**，直接返回那张卡的 `name` 与匹配理由，让模型改用 `update`。
- `update`：合并进指定卡。合并按 `##` 段落进行——模型这次写到的段落被替换，**没提到的段落原样保留**，因此后一次保存不会悄悄抹掉先前的结论。`revision` 递增，`triggers` / `tags` 取并集。
- `force-create`：确实是一个不同任务时才用。

索引有硬上限（默认 50 张，按加载次数→更新时间排序）。被截断的卡仍然可以通过 `task_memory_index` / `task_memory_search` 找到——这是"记忆可以很长，但每次不必全读"的落地方式。

## 记忆面板（P3）

Harness 侧边栏里的「任务记忆」入口，中间列打开面板。**左侧是卡片列表、右侧是详情/编辑区**，两列各自滚动——详情不会因为你记忆变多而被推得越来越远。

| 操作 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 浏览 | 顶部选工作区（带卡片数），左栏列表：名字、状态、描述、更新时间、revision、加载次数、触发词 |
| 查看 | 点左栏卡片，右栏显示正文与元数据 |
| 新建 | 点右上角「新建卡片」，在右栏填写；勾选**「作为技能上架」**（默认不勾） |
| 编辑 | 右栏直接改字段与正文后保存；上架开关也在这里 |
| 删除 | 二次确认，删掉卡片及其全部附件（外键级联） |
| 检索 | 按正文全文过滤左栏列表 |

**状态显示中文**：「已确认 / 草稿 / 可能过时」。存储里仍然是 `verified / draft / stale` 标识符 —— 面板只翻译**显示**，因为那三个词是工具 schema 和数据库列使用的值，就地改写会破坏与模型的契约。

**人工编辑与模型写入的语义不同**：模型 `update` 是按 `##` 段落合并，而面板保存是**逐字替换**——你在编辑器里写的就是最终内容，删掉的段落和触发词不会自己回来。

实现要点：Host 侧用 `ctx.webServer.register` 挂 `/api/task-memory/*` 六条路由，客户端用 `fetch` 调用，两个 slot（`sidebar.panellist` + `main`）提供入口和页面。样式只用主题 token，明暗主题都跟随宿主。

界面里的下拉框是**自绘**的，不是原生 `<select>`：后者的展开弹层由 Chromium/OS 绘制、CSS 碰不到，在暗色主题下会是白底黑字，与其余控件格格不入。自绘版直接采用宿主菜单的配方（`--dsw-menu-surface-fill` + `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` + `--dsw-elevation-prominent`），并保留原生控件的全部键盘与无障碍行为（方向键、Home/End、Enter/Space、Escape、点外部关闭、焦点回到触发器）。

## 安装

本插件不使用 npm 安装、没有 `node_modules`、不依赖任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包——`link:` 安装的插件是从真实路径加载的，Node 的解析走不到 profile 的 `node_modules`，所以裸包名会失败。`lib/schema.js` 因此自己实现了注册契约。

1. 加依赖（`link:` 指向本目录）：
   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-task-memory": "link:D:/AI/dsh-task-memory" }
   ```
2. 加进 bundles：
   ```json
   "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-task-memory" ]
   ```
3. 建 junction，让 Node 能解析到它：
   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-task-memory" `
     -Target "D:\AI\dsh-task-memory"
   ```

## 配置

```yaml
- id: dsh-task-memory
  name: dsh-task-memory
  config:
    maxCatalogCards: 50     # 注入索引的卡片上限
    maxBodyChars: 24000     # 单张卡正文的读取上限，超出截断并给出数据库位置
    includeSystemPrompt: true
    autoCapture: true       # 回合结束自动追问是否落卡；设 false 关闭
    defaultTiers: [recent]  # 面板默认显示哪些档位
    tierDays:               # 新鲜度档位的天数边界，必须递增
      past: 7               # ≤7 天算「近期」
      old: 30               # ≤30 天算「之前」
      ancient: 90           # ≤90 天算「很久之前」
      forgotten: 365        # ≤365 天算「远古」，超过则「遗忘」
```

这些都可以在「设置 → 任务记忆」里改，改完立即生效并存进设置文

plugins.description: Balance and spending of an arckep.ru account inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Unofficial community plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-arckep

English | [Русский](README.ru.md)

Shows the **balance and spending of your [arckep.ru](https://arckep.ru) account** right inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web UI: a small badge
with the balance in the session header and at the foot of the sidebar, a panel with the details,
and a settings page for the API key.

> **Unofficial.** This is a community plugin. It is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with
> DeepSeek. arckep.ru is the third-party service the plugin connects to; you need your own
> arckep.ru account and API key.

## What you get

- **Badge** in the header of an open session: the balance as `1 234,50 ₽`. It turns to a
  warning colour when the balance is below your threshold (default 100 ₽) or when the forecast
  says the money lasts less than 3 days. Click it to open the panel.
- **Sidebar badge**: the same balance (icon and amount) at the foot of the sidebar, above
  Settings, so it is visible on the empty start screen too, with the same warning rules. Click it
  to open the same panel. You can switch it off in Settings → Arckep.
- **Panel**: balance (with a note for a corporate wallet), spending for today / 7 days / 30 days,
  the top 5 models by cost, "enough for about N days", "updated N min ago" and a refresh button.
- **Settings → Arckep**: the API key field (it is cleared after saving and only shows that a key
  is set), *Save* / *Delete key*, "count spending for this key only", the polling interval
  (default 300 s, minimum 60 s), the warning threshold, "show the balance in the sidebar" and the
  interface language.
- Russian and English interface, following the DSH language (Russian when it cannot be
  determined, English for other DSH languages). DSH itself ships English and Chinese, so a
  Russian reader can switch the plugin to Russian in Settings → Arckep. Colours come from the DSH
  theme, so light and dark themes work.
- If arckep.ru is unreachable, the last good numbers stay on screen and are marked
  "data is out of date".

The header badge exists only while a session is open. The sidebar badge does not depend on a
session. When the sidebar is collapsed to its narrow rail it shows only the ruble icon (hover or
focus it for the amount), so nothing wraps or is cut off. Both badges share one state and one
panel: only one panel is open at a time, a refresh in one place shows in the other at once, and
the second badge makes no extra requests.

## Requirements

- DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** or newer with the web UI (`dsh web`). DSH is a developer preview and its plugin
  APIs are still changing, see [Compatibility](#compatibility). DSH itself needs Node.js 22.19+
  (or 24+); the plugin has no other requirement.
- A DSH profile that includes the web app (the shipped `web` profile does).
- An arckep.ru API key with the **`balance:read`** scope.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-arckep
dsh web
```

(`web` is the profile name; use your own profile if you have one.) There is no build step and
no install script, so nothing else needs to be allowed or built. The package is on npm from version 0.1.2.

To install straight from GitHub instead, or to pin an exact commit or tag:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gmen1057/dsh-arckep
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gmen1057/dsh-arckep#<commit-or-tag>
```

Check that the layer is active with `dsh --profile web --dump-config` (look for the
`# == dsh-arckep` block). Remove the plugin with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-arckep`.

### Desktop app

DSH Desktop owns its own profile, `desktop`. As the DSH docs describe: launch the app once,
**quit it completely**, run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-arckep` (with the
`dsh` command that ships with the app), then reopen the app. For the `desktop` profile
`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` is refused ("managed exclusively by the Electron
application"), so the only check is the badge at the foot of the sidebar (or in the header of an open session). The author has not
tested the plugin in the desktop app.

## Set the key

1. On arckep.ru open **Settings → API** and create a key. It needs access to the **balance**
   (`balance:read`). New keys have it by default; a dedicated key with only this scope is the safest
   choice.
2. In DSH open **Settings → Arckep**, paste the key and press **Save**. The field is cleared and
   the page says "Key is set".

Alternatively export `ARCKEP_API_KEY` before starting DSH. DSH's rule applies: an environment
variable wins over a stored key, and the settings page then shows the key as read-only.

## Settings

| Setting | Default | Where it is stored |
|---|---|---|
| API key | none | DSH credential store (`ARCKEP_API_KEY`), see Privacy |
| Show the balance in the sidebar | on | this browser |
| Count spending for this key only | off | this browser |
| Polling interval | 300 s (minimum 60 s) | this browser |
| Warn when the balance is below | 100 ₽ | this browser |
| Interface language | same as DSH | this browser |

The three display settings above the language can also get deployment-wide defaults by overriding the `arckep` row in your
profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: arckep
  config:
    refreshSeconds: 600
    warnBelowRub: 300
    keyOnly: false
```

Anything the user changes in Settings → Arckep overrides these defaults in that browser.

## How it behaves

- The DSH **server** calls arckep.ru, never the browser. The browser only talks to DSH.
- Requests are made only while a DSH page is open and visible, and only when the cached answer is
  older than the polling interval. There are no background timers on the server.
- One request at a time, 10 s timeout, no redirects followed. After errors the next automatic
  attempt is delayed 30 s, 60 s, 120 s ... up to 30 minutes (and by `Retry-After` for HTTP 429).
- 401 (wrong key) and 403 (missing scope) are not retried automatically; press *Refresh* after you
  fix the key.
- Spending details come from `GET /api/v1/usage`. If the arckep.ru server does not provide that
  endpoint yet (HTTP 404), the plugin keeps showing the balance and hides the spending block
  without any error. It probes again from time to time.

## Privacy and security

- The plugin talks to **`https://arckep.ru` only**: `GET /api/v1/balance` and
  `GET /api/v1/usage?days=30&key_only=...`. The host and the https scheme are checked in code; a
  redirect (any 3xx answer) is treated as an error and never followed.
- **No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party requests.** The plugin writes no files of its own;
  the only thing persisted by DSH is the key, in its credential store. The display settings
  live in your browser's `localStorage`.
- The key is sent in the `Authorization: Bearer` header to arckep.ru and nowhere else. It is
  never put in `cordis.patch.yml`, in the URL, in logs, in error messages, or in anything sent to
  the browser; the browser only learns whether a key is set and where it comes from.
- The plugin's four routes live on DSH's own authenticated `/api` channel, so they are protected
  by DSH's Host/Origin checks and its browser-session cookie. State-changing requests additionally
  require a JSON content type and a same-origin request.
- **Know where the key is stored.** DSH's local credential store is a file in `$DSH_HOME`
  (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, mode 600). Tools that DSH's agent runs execute as the same OS user,
  so they can read it. That is a property of DSH, not of this plugin. Limit the damage: create a
  key that only has `balance:read`, and revoke it on arckep.ru if you suspect it leaked.
- The standard proxy variables that DSH honours (see DSH's network-proxy guide) apply, because the
  plugin uses the host's regular `fetch`. I have not tested a proxied setup.

Report vulnerabilities privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Troubleshooting

| You see | Meaning |
|---|---|
| "arckep.ru rejected the key (401)" | wrong or revoked key; paste a new one |
| "The key lacks the required access (balance:read)" | create a key with the *balance* scope |
| "Cannot reach arckep.ru" / "did not ans

plugins.description: Manoo: manos para DeepSeek Harness. Ve tu pantalla, mueve el mouse y escribe por ti ‚Äî barra, aro para ense√±ar y voz, en espa√±ol, para quien no sabe usar la computadora. macOS.
plugins.readme_text:
# Manoo · manos para DeepSeek Harness

## 中文说明 · Chinese · 中文

Manoo 给 DeepSeek Harness 一双手：它能看你的屏幕、移动鼠标、替你打字，而且是
**当着你的面**做，一边做一边念给你听。它是为**不太会用电脑的人**做的，
界面有**中文**（状态栏 声音 / 光标 / 分屏 / 缩放 / 暂停、权限询问、声音朗读）。
适合：让 AI 帮你操作电脑、看屏幕、点按钮、填表格；不懂电脑的人也能用。

![中文状态栏：声音 · 光标 · 分屏 · 缩放 · 暂停](captura-bar-zh.png)

**这个仓库只是连接器**，不含 Manoo 程序本身；程序在
https://manoo-deepseek.corporacionjamiel.workers.dev/ 单独下载（有免费额度）。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add manoo-manos   # 装连接器
node instalar.mjs                          # 告诉它 Manoo 装在哪里
```

完整中文说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

---


**Manoo le da manos a DeepSeek**: ve tu pantalla, mueve el mouse y escribe por ti.
Le pides las cosas como se las pedirías a una persona —«abre el navegador y busca
el clima», «enséñame dónde está el botón de guardar»— y lo hace delante de ti, con
una **barra** en la pantalla, un **aro** que te señala dónde picar y **voz** que te
va contando.

Está hecho para **quien no sabe usar la computadora**, en **español**, y para que
termines la sesión **habiendo aprendido algo**, no solo con el resultado.

![Manoo trabajando con DeepSeek: el chat a la izquierda, los resultados a la derecha y el aro señalando el primer resultado](captura.png)

---

## Qué es este paquete (y qué no)

Este repositorio es **solo el conector**: le dice a DeepSeek Harness cómo hablar con
Manoo usando el puente oficial `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. **No contiene el
programa Manoo.**

El programa se descarga aparte en **https://manoo.corporacionjamiel.workers.dev/**
(hay **prueba gratis de 25 acciones** por sesión; Pro es ilimitado). Se instala en
tu Mac y este conector lo engancha al harness.

## Instalación (dos pasos)

**1. Instala el conector** desde el Plugin Market del harness, o a mano:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add manoo-manos
```

**2. Baja Manoo y apúntale la ruta**

Descarga Manoo de https://manoo.corporacionjamiel.workers.dev/, descomprímelo en tu
carpeta personal como `manoo`, y corre:

```bash
node instalar.mjs
```

Eso escribe la ruta real de tu copia en el conector. Después **reinicia DeepSeek
Harness** y ya puedes pedirle cosas. Si tienes Manoo en otro lado:

```bash
MANOO_HOME=/ruta/a/manoo node instalar.mjs
```

## Cómo se usa

Escribe lo que quieres, como se lo dirías a una persona:

- **«ayúdame a llenar este formulario»** → Manoo hace los pasos de rutina y te deja
  solo lo que es tuyo: la contraseña, el botón que paga o firma.
- **«enséñame dónde está guardar»** → no toca nada: te señala con el **aro** y espera
  a que lo hagas tú.
- **«hazlo tú»** → lo hace sin preguntarte en los pasos de rutina.

Con el switch 🔊 de la barra te lo va **diciendo en voz alta**. Con la ✕ la barra se
apaga; con ⏸ **Manoo no toca nada** hasta que lo quites.

## Permisos que pide (macOS)

| Permiso | Para qué |
|---|---|
| **Accesibilidad** | mover el mouse, escribir y leer los botones de las apps |
| **Grabación de pantalla** | ver la pantalla cuando hace falta una captura |
| **Monitoreo de entrada** | el **paro de emergencia**: si tocas el mouse o el teclado, Manoo se detiene |

Sin el tercero, el paro no funciona: Manoo lo revisa al instalar y te lo dice.

## Lo que Manoo no hace (está en el código, no en un texto)

- **No escribe contraseñas, PIN, tarjetas ni códigos.** Nunca.
- **No pica el botón final** que paga, transfiere, firma, publica o envía: te dice
  dónde está y lo das tú.
- **No entra a apps de dinero, inversión, cripto, gestores de contraseñas ni
  autoridad fiscal** — no las abre ni las mira.
- **Si tocas el mouse o el teclado, se detiene** y te pregunta si sigue.
- Pide permiso **la primera vez que toca cada app**, con el aro sobre «Permitir».

## Privacidad, en claro

Manoo corre en tu computadora y **no manda nada a servidores nuestros**. Lo que Manoo
ve (texto de la pantalla y capturas) va a la **API de DeepSeek**, que lo procesa y lo
guarda en **China**. La licencia y el cobro los maneja la tienda; el aviso completo
está en https://manoo.corporacionjamiel.workers.dev/privacidad.html

## Alcance

Hoy **solo macOS**. Windows y Linux están en el proyecto de la versión para Claude.

## Licencia

El conector es gratis y se puede compartir tal cual; el **programa Manoo es aparte**
y tiene su propia licencia y precio. Ver [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Aviso

Manoo es un producto independiente de **Corporación Jamiel**. **No está afiliado a
DeepSeek AI ni a Anthropic**: «DeepSeek» y «Claude» son marcas de sus dueños y aquí
se usan solo para decir con qué funciona.

Hecho por **Jamiel García Velázquez** · © 2026

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a model-facing `chrome` tool that drives the installed Google Chrome over CDP — screenshots returned as images, DOM/text/eval, console & network diagnostics, real input events. Runs in the Host, so no per-call approval and no bash sandbox limits.
plugins.readme_text:
# chrome-browser

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the model a
`chrome` tool: it drives the **Google Chrome installed on the machine** over the Chrome DevTools
Protocol, so front-end work can navigate, screenshot, inspect, and interact with real rendered pages.

The tool runs inside the Harness Host process, which has two consequences worth knowing:

- **No per-call approval.** A `chrome` call is an ordinary tool call; it never asks for shell or
  sandbox permission.
- **It is not affected by the shell sandbox.** On Linux, Chrome cannot start under a Landlock-confined
  shell (it aborts with `chrome_crashpad_handler: --database is required`), so a plain
  `google-chrome --headless …` bash command fails on a hardened Host. The Host process is not confined,
  and the plugin runs there.

Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows: the browser is located per platform, the sandbox flag follows the
platform, and Windows process-tree teardown uses `taskkill`.

Screenshots are returned as real images in the tool result (when the model route accepts image
input) **and** written to a file, so the model sees the rendered UI while a human can open the exact
PNG afterwards.

A real render, captured by the tool itself — [astro.build](https://astro.build/) at 1280×800:

![astro.build rendered in headless Chrome by the chrome tool](demo/astro-home.png)

## Tool reference

One tool, `chrome`, with an `action` parameter. Page ids (`p1`, `p2`, …) come from `open`; every
later action takes an optional `page` and otherwise uses the most recent one.

| Action | Key parameters | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `url`, `width`, `height`, `deviceScaleFactor`, `mobile` | Starts Chrome if needed, opens a page. |
| `goto` | `url`, `page` | Navigates an open page and waits for load. |
| `screenshot` | `path`, `fullPage`, `selector`, `width`, `height`, `scale` | PNG image + saved path; viewport by default. |
| `viewport` | `width`, `height`, `deviceScaleFactor`, `mobile` | Resizes the emulated viewport (responsive checks). |
| `dom` | `selector`, `maxChars` | `outerHTML` of the document or of one element. |
| `text` | `selector`, `maxChars` | `innerText` of the body or of one element. |
| `eval` | `expression`, `maxChars` | Evaluates JavaScript in the page, returns the JSON value. |
| `click` | `selector` or `x`/`y`, `button`, `clickCount` | Real mouse events at the element centre. |
| `type` | `selector`, `text`, `clear`, `submit`, `delayMs` | Focuses, clears, inserts real input events. |
| `press` | `key` | `Enter`, `Tab`, `Escape`, arrows, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`, `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Space`. |
| `wait_for` | `selector` or `text`, `timeoutMs` | Polls until the selector matches or the text appears. |
| `console` | `clear`, `limit` | Collected `console.*` calls, uncaught exceptions, browser log entries. |
| `network` | `clear`, `limit` | Failed requests and HTTP 4xx/5xx responses seen while attached. |
| `pdf` | `path` | Prints the page to a PDF file. |
| `tabs` | – | Lists open pages. |
| `close` | `page` | Closes one page. |
| `stop` | – | Terminates Chrome and removes its temporary profile. |

## Requirements

- Google Chrome or Chromium (any recent version; developed against Chrome 155), on Linux, macOS, or
  Windows. Chromium-based Microsoft Edge is accepted as a last resort on Windows.
- Node.js 22+ (uses the global `WebSocket`).
- No npm dependencies: the plugin imports only its sibling module and Node.js built-ins.
- For CJK pages install a CJK font (`apt-get install fonts-noto-cjk` on Debian/Ubuntu, or the Noto CJK
  fonts on Windows/macOS); without one, screenshots render those glyphs as empty boxes.

## Install into a Harness profile

The Host imports plugins only from its own module roots (the profile and the dsh installation), so the
bundle must be installed as a **real copy inside the profile**, not as a link to a checkout:

```bash
npm pack                    # -> local-dsh-chrome-browser-<version>.tgz
```

Then install that tarball through the Harness plugin manager (`plugin_manager`, `action:
install_bundle`, `target` = absolute tarball path). The Host reports `restart-required` when it
replaces an already installed package; restart `dsh web` to load the new module generation. A
version bump changes the dependency spec, which is what makes an update detectable.

## Configuration

The bundle patch sets these; `apply` merges them over its own defaults and validates them.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `chromePath` | `''` (auto-detect) | Browser executable. |
| `headless` | `true` | Run without a window. |
| `noSandbox` | `true` on POSIX, `false` on Windows | Pass `--no-sandbox`; required when the Host runs as root, unnecessary on Windows. |
| `userDataDir` | `''` (fresh temp dir per start) | Chrome profile directory; set it to a plain ASCII path if the system temp path upsets Chrome. |
| `defaultWidth` / `defaultHeight` | `1280` / `900` | Default viewport. |
| `maxOutputChars` | `100000` | Default cap for `dom`/`text`/`eval` output. |
| `navigationTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Navigation and `wait_for` budget. |
| `artifactDir` | `''` (system temp) | Where screenshots and PDFs go when no `path` is given. |

### How Chrome is located

The tool schema has **no path parameter**: the model never needs to know where the browser lives.
`resolveChromePath` resolves in this order and fails with an actionable message naming the config key
when nothing matches:

1. the row's `chromePath` config;
2. the `DSH_CHROME_PATH` environment variable;
3. the probe list for the running platform:
   - **Linux** — `/usr/bin/google-chrome`, `google-chrome-stable`, `google-chrome-beta`,
     `/usr/bin/chromium`, `chromium-browser`, `/opt/google/chrome/chrome`, `/snap/bin/chromium`,
     `/var/lib/flatpak/exports/bin/com.google.Chrome`;
   - **macOS** — `/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome`, the Chromium bundle,
     and the per-user `~/Applications` copy;
   - **Windows** — `%ProgramFiles%` and `%ProgramFiles(x86)%` `\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`,
     `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`, then
     `%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`.

For an unusual installation, set `DSH_CHROME_PATH` for the Host or edit the row's `chromePath` — no
code change is needed.

### Platform notes

| Platform | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Linux | Chrome runs with `--no-sandbox` by default because the Host usually runs as root. A Landlock-confined shell cannot start Chrome at all (`chrome_crashpad_handler: --database is required`); the Host process is not confined, which is where this plugin runs. |
| macOS | Same code path as Linux apart from the probe list; `--no-sandbox` is likewise the default. |
| Windows | `--no-sandbox` is off by default, the process is spawned with `windowsHide` (no console window), and `stop`/disposal terminates the whole tree with `taskkill /pid <pid> /T /F` — Windows has no POSIX process groups, so a plain `child.kill()` would leave renderers and the crashpad handler behind. |

If Chrome exits before exposing a DevTools endpoint on Windows, the usual causes are a policy block on
`--remote-debugging-port`, antivirus interception, or a profile path the browser cannot use; set
`userDataDir` to a plain ASCII directory to rule out the last one.

## Tests

Two dependency-free suites drive real Chrome (no test framework required):

```bash
node test/engine.test.mjs   # CDP engine: browser resolution per platform, navigation, capture, input, console, network, teardown
node test/tool.test.mjs     # the real tool definition: schema validation, every action, error paths
```

Run them from the repository root; `tool.test.mjs` writes throwaway screenshots under `.tmp/`. Browser
resolution is injectable, so the Linux/macOS/Windows probe lists are covered even when the suite runs
on one of them.

## Operational notes

- Chrome starts lazily on the first action and runs with a fresh temporary profile; `stop` (or plugin
  disposal) terminates it and removes that profile. With `userDataDir` set, that directory is left in
  place instead.
- One Chro

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-text-explain

[简体中文](README.zh.md) ｜ English

**Made for people who don't speak AI.** Select a passage in a DeepSeek Harness
conversation — a term, an error message, a wall of jargon — and get it explained
in plain words, right where you are reading.

![Demo: select a confusing passage, read the plain-words explanation, ask a follow-up, then hand the thread to a new session](assets/demo.gif)

*40 seconds, unedited: a Godot build file explained as 「`.exe` is the cow, `.pck` is the suitcase — the cow and the suitcase have to travel together」, followed by two follow-up questions.*

## Why this exists

AI output is full of words you are expected to already know. The usual advice is
"just ask the model" — but you have to know *what* to ask, and the answer often
comes back in the same jargon you were stuck on.

This plugin removes that step: **select the confusing part, click once, read the
plain-words version.** No prompt engineering, no second tab, no API key.

## Features

- **Context-aware.** When you select text, it also grabs the *whole message* the
  passage came from and hands both to the model. "It will transfer the funds at
  the end" is ambiguous — until the model can see that "it" means the finance
  department.
- **Depth knob (讲给谁听).** Three depths — **Plain / General / Pro**,
  defaulting to Plain. Switch one and it **re-explains the current question on
  the spot**: the same sentence goes from kitchen-table analogy to engineering
  vocabulary. A switch in the popup lasts that popup only; set a default in
  Settings and press Save.
- **Standby handoff (✦ New session).** The button packs the selection, its
  source message and everything already asked into a handoff document, drops it
  into a fresh session and jumps you there. **The new session answers with a
  single line — "背景已了解，等你开口" — and waits**: no summary, no
  questions, no expansion. You already had your explanation; the new session is
  for what comes next.
- **Markdown rendering.** Answers render with headings, lists, quotes, code
  blocks, **tables** and links — via a hand-written, dependency-free renderer
  built from React elements (so it is XSS-safe by construction).
- **Web search and local files (optional).** Two toggles let the model call
  `web_search` / `web_fetch` for current information, and `search_files` /
  `read_file` to look things up in your local docs.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HEArtattaCK2332/dsh-text-explain
```

Then restart the Web profile so the new bundle layer is loaded.

<details>
<summary>From a local checkout instead</summary>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<path-to-dsh-text-explain>
```

</details>

## Usage

1. **Select text** in any conversation message. The popup automatically carries
   that message along as context.
2. Click **AI 解释** to explain it, or **追问** to ask a question about it.
3. Read the streamed answer. Type a follow-up and press Enter to keep the same
   thread; close the window with ✕.
4. Switch depth with **讲给谁听** at the bottom of the popup. Changing it
   re-explains the current question immediately.
5. Toggle **🌐 联网** / **📄 读文件** before asking, if you want the model to
   search the web or read local files.
6. Click **✦ 新建为对话** when the thread is worth pursuing: the whole exchange
   lands in a new session as a **handoff**, which opens automatically and waits
   for you to speak.
7. Open **设置 → 划词解释** for defaults: which workspace a new session lands
   in, the default depth, and (under 高级设置) whether the two toggles start on.

## Settings

Settings live on the host, in `<DSH_HOME>/text-explain/settings.json`
(`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`). The settings page keeps a **draft**: every
click only edits that draft, **保存** writes the whole file, **刷新** throws the
draft away and re-reads what is stored. **Nothing you did not save is ever
written to disk** — not to the config file, not to browser storage (this plugin
stores nothing in the browser at all).

## Browser extension

The same backend also powers a browser extension: select any passage on any web
page and read the explanation in a floating panel (three depths, switchable on
the spot). Source lives in [`extension/`](extension/) with its own
[README](extension/README.md).

**You do not need DSH to use it.** The extension offers three backends:

- **Free models** (easiest) — endpoints and model names are pre-filled; all you do
  is apply for a free key at the provider. Recommended: Zhipu GLM-4.7-Flash, free
  and reachable from mainland China without a proxy. Also Qwen, Gemini, Groq,
  OpenRouter, or a local Ollama / LM Studio.
- **Local DeepSeek Harness** — talks to this plugin, so web search and
  hand-off-to-a-new-session work as well.
- **Your own API** — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

The three depth levels work identically in all three.

Load it unpacked: open `chrome://extensions/`, turn on **Developer mode**, click
**Load unpacked**, and pick the `extension/` folder.

## Use it from other apps

The host half also speaks the **OpenAI chat-completions protocol**, so any client
that accepts a custom API base URL can use this plugin as its backend — Obsidian
plugins, browser extensions, your own scripts.

```
Base URL : http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/text-explain/v1
API key  : anything (or leave it empty)
Model    : text-explain-plain | text-explain-general | text-explain-pro
```

- `GET /models` lists the three depths.
- `POST /chat/completions` takes the standard shape and supports `stream: true` (SSE).
- **The model name picks the depth**: `text-explain-plain` is the default voice
  (for people who don't speak AI), `text-explain-pro` the most technical.
- A `system` message from the caller is **ignored on purpose** — the whole point
  of this plugin is that the explanation style is not up to the caller.
- Callers **without** an `Origin` header (`curl`, local scripts) work out of the
  box. Callers **with** one must be listed in `allowedOrigins` (see Design notes) —
  desktop apps included: **Obsidian sends `Origin: app://obsidian.md`**, so that
  exact line belongs in the allowlist.

## Tests

Three stub-based self-check suites ship in the box. They need nothing but Node's
built-in modules — no test framework, no `npm install`:

```sh
node test/run-all.mjs         # all three; or run any single file
```

- `test/host.test.mjs` — drives the real HTTP endpoints against a fake
  `llm` / `webServer`: the three depths must produce three **different** system
  prompts; an unknown `level` must fall back to `plain` (never an error);
  context must still be injected; an empty selection must be rejected. It also
  checks the settings endpoint creates no file until you save, sanitizes dirty
  input, and leaves stored settings untouched on a bad payload. Everything is
  written to a temp `DSH_HOME`, never your real one.
- `test/settings.test.mjs` — loads `lib/client.js` against React / fetch stubs:
  module shape, slot registration, settings normalization, cache behaviour,
  failure fallbacks, and the rule that matters — **only Save issues a POST**.
  The `window` stub deliberately has no `localStorage`, proving browser storage
  is really gone.
- `test/render.test.mjs` — renders both components on a React stub: the settings
  page (loading / ready / error, collapsed and expanded) and the popup with a
  full Markdown answer, exercising the hand-written renderer.

## Design notes

- The selected text goes to `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-v4-flash` by
  default; no separate API key is stored by this plugin.
- Intentionally dependency-free and hand-written: **no build step**.
- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers `POST /api/text-explain` and
  `GET/POST /api/text-explain/settings` as *exact* routes. The four depth
  prompts share one skeleton (「语境」/「格式」are common; only 「读者 + 怎么讲」
  differ), so a single code path serves all four.
- **Context** comes from the DOM: the client walks up from the selection anchor
  to the outermost ancestor that still fits the same message (capped at 4000
  characters). If that walk fails, the explanation still works — just without
  context.
- **Web search** uses Bing's RSS endpoint (`format=rs

plugins.description: DSH literature fetcher: search academic papers, download PDFs via Sci-Hub/Open Access, generate batch manifests
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lit-fetch

DSH literature fetcher — search academic papers, download PDFs by DOI (Sci-Hub mirrors with Open Access fallback), and generate a batch-access HTML manifest.

DSH 文献获取插件 — 快捷搜索学术文献、通过 DOI 批量下载 PDF（Sci-Hub 镜像 + 开放获取兜底）、生成批量获取清单 HTML。

## 功能总览 · At a glance（中英对照 / Bilingual）

### 检索 / Search

| 中文 | English |
|---|---|
| `search_papers`：按 DOI 精确查询（Crossref） | `search_papers`: exact DOI lookup via Crossref |
| 按标题/关键词检索（OpenAlex，最多 20 条） | Title/keyword search via OpenAlex, up to 20 results |
| 返回标题、作者、期刊、年份、DOI、官方链接 | Returns title, authors, journal, year, DOI and canonical link |

### 下载 / Download

| 中文 | English |
|---|---|
| `download_papers`：按 DOI 批量下载 PDF | `download_papers`: batch PDF download by DOI |
| Sci-Hub 优先：遍历 8 个镜像域名，解析 iframe/embed 取直链 | Sci-Hub first: walks 8 mirrors, resolves the PDF link from iframe/embed |
| 开放获取兜底：Unpaywall 查 OA 免费版本 | OA fallback: Unpaywall lookup for a free version |
| PDF 魔数校验（`%PDF-`）+ 最小体积校验（≥3KB）拦截假文件 | Magic-byte (`%PDF-`) and minimum-size (≥3 KB) checks reject bogus files |
| 并发下载（默认 4，上限 8），先写 `.part` 再原子重命名 | Concurrent downloads (default 4, max 8), `.part` then atomic rename |
| 每篇返回状态：`ok` / `scihub-fail` / `oa-fail` / `closed-access` / `no-doi` | Per-paper status: `ok` / `scihub-fail` / `oa-fail` / `closed-access` / `no-doi` |
| 结果写入 `_lit_fetch_report.json` | Writes `_lit_fetch_report.json` into the output directory |

### 清单 / Manifest

| 中文 | English |
|---|---|
| `generate_manifest`：把拿不到的文献生成可点击清单 | `generate_manifest`: clickable list of papers that could not be fetched |
| 输出「批量获取入口.html」，含 DOI 官方链接与状态徽章 | Emits `批量获取入口.html` with DOI links and status badges |
| 提供「顺序打开全部」按钮，逐条间隔 800ms 打开 | A "open all in order" button opens each link 800 ms apart |

### 宿主路由 / Host route

| 中文 | English |
|---|---|
| 注册 `/lit-fetch` 前缀路由，返回插件存活与版本信息 | Registers a `/lit-fetch` prefix route reporting liveness and version |

## 使用方式 · Usage

在 DSH 对话中对 agent 说 / Talk to the agent in a DSH session：

1. **搜索 · Search**：「帮我找关于 static mixer CFD 的文献」→ agent 调用 `search_papers`
2. **下载 · Download**：「把这些 DOI 下载到 `D:\papers\`」→ agent 调用 `download_papers`
3. **生成清单 · Manifest**：「给没下载到的文献生成获取清单」→ agent 调用 `generate_manifest`

## 下载策略 · Download strategy

1. **Sci-Hub 优先**：遍历 8 个域名（sci-hub.ren / ee / st / ru / se / wf / hk、tesble.com），
   解析 iframe/embed 提取 PDF 直链，流式下载并校验 `%PDF` 魔数。
2. **开放获取兜底**：Sci-Hub 无收录时查 Unpaywall，寻找 OA 免费版本（`best_oa_location` 优先，
   其次遍历 `oa_locations`）。
3. **最终兜底**：两者均失败 → 记入清单，生成 HTML 供手动获取（向作者索取 / NSTL 文献传递）。

> Sci-Hub first — walks the 8 mirrors, resolves the direct PDF link from iframe/embed.
> OA fallback — Unpaywall when Sci-Hub has nothing. Final fallback — the HTML manifest.

## 已知限制 · Known limitations

- Sci-Hub 2021 年后基本停止收录新文献（Elsevier/Wiley/ACS 2021+ 文章大概率无收录）。
- 直连 Sci-Hub 镜像较慢（Cloudflare 限速），建议开启 VPN/代理后使用。
- OA 兜底仅查 Unpaywall；某些文献有 arXiv 预印本但 Unpaywall 未收录。
- Sci-Hub stopped indexing new papers after 2021, and mirror throughput is often throttled.
  The OA fallback only consults Unpaywall.

## 安装 · Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-lit-fetch
# 或从本地目录 link
# cp -r dsh-lit-fetch ~/.dsh/local-plugins/
```

## 技术细节 · Technical notes

- 宿主端纯 Node.js，无 Python 依赖 / Host-side pure Node.js, no Python dependency
- PDF 魔数校验 + 体积校验 / Magic-byte and size validation
- 流式下载 + 原子落盘（`.part` → rename）/ Streaming download with atomic rename
- 并发控制（默认 4，最大 8）/ Bounded concurrency
- 下载报告 JSON 自动落盘 / Automatic JSON report

## License

MIT

# Seller Protocol [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) [![Validate](https://github.com/nx9161/seller-protocol/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nx9161/seller-protocol/actions/workflows/validate.yml) > An autonomous virtual office for Amazon FBA + direct-to-consumer > e-commerce. Say the phrase, and **Mercer** — Chief Operator — runs > 19 specialists across 8 divisions: what to sell, sourcing it from > China, shipping, warehousing, listing, and selling — legally and > profitably. ## ⚡ Activate this office Paste this to any AI agent: > I want to use Seller Protocol from nx9161's github public repo. For maximum reliability (some AIs can't browse or search fresh repos), paste this full block instead: > I want to use Seller Protocol from nx9161's github public repo. > Fetch this exact URL — do not web-search for it: > https://github.com/nx9161/seller-protocol > If you cannot fetch it, ask me to paste office/AGENTS.md and I will. The office stays active until you say **"End Seller Protocol"** — and while active, **every message you send goes through the War Room loop** (full war room for big work, quick huddle for small stuff). Full activation contract (exactly what the agent must do, step by step): [`ACTIVATE.md`](ACTIVATE.md). ## 🔌 Install as a DeepSeek Harness plugin Rather paste nothing at all? Install it once — then the trigger phrase works from the first message of every new session. In the Harness plugin screen, enter the GitHub address: ``` nx9161/seller-protocol ``` or via CLI: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:nx9161/seller-protocol # local clone also works: dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/seller-protocol ``` Then open a **new** session. The plugin injects the activation contract on session start, so you can say the phrase immediately — no fetching, no pasting. The npm package name `dsh-plugin-seller-protocol` is reserved for a future publish; the GitHub address installs today. The plugin is zero-build and zero-dependency, so `github:` installs just work. ## What this is The entire pipeline from product idea to money in the bank, as agent profiles: product research, China sourcing and factory QC, freight and forwarder selection, warehousing, Amazon FBA operations, listings and PPC, Shopify and web storefronts, outstanding UI, international trade law, and finance. Mercer handles everything and reports to you. Sister project: **[War Room Protocol](https://github.com/nx9161/war-room-protocol)** — the same operating model for software, led by Sloane. ## How it works **The Chief.** Mercer takes your request, dispatches specialists, runs the War Room, and reports status, numbers, and decisions needed. The business, handled. **The pipeline** — idea to money in the bank: ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Idea] --> B[War Room
Phases 0–4] B --> C[Sample 💰] C --> D[Contract
lawyer review 💰] D --> E[Bulk + QC 💰] E --> F[Freight 💰] F --> G[Warehouse / Prep] G --> H[List] H --> I[Launch] I --> J[30-day P&L review] ``` 💰 = owner approval required (money rule — every dollar, in writing). **The seats — 20 roles, 8 divisions.** | Division | Seats | |---|---| | Sourcing & Supply Chain | China Sourcing Expert, Vendor Picker (China ground agent) | | Logistics & Warehousing | Shipping Expert, Warehouse Expert | | Marketplaces | Amazon FBA Specialist, Amazon Services Expert, Product Suggester | | Digital Storefront | Website Expert, Shopify Expert, UI Designer, Product Visualizer, Art Director | | Legal & Finance | International Trade Lawyer, Finance & Tax Counsel | | Intelligence | Prompt Writer, Knowledge Wizard | | Growth & Brand | Launch Strategist, SEO Specialist, Social Media Strategist | | **Leadership** | **Mercer (Chief Operator)** | Three seats can **block**: the Vendor Picker (failed QC), the Trade Lawyer (compliance), and Finance Counsel (tax/financial compliance). Blocks stand until cleared or the owner accepts the risk in writing. **Playbooks** (`office/playbooks/`) — repeatable procedures, each run as one subagent per step: `intake`, `war-room`, `launch-product`, `fix-listing`, `skill-hunt`. **The War Room** — runs before any product launch, inventory buy, or freight booking: - **Phase 0 (mandatory gate):** the Prompt Writer perfects your raw prompt; the Knowledge Wizard parses every word, searches each term, reads all related official docs in full, and briefs every seat. No seat speaks before the dossier lands. - **Phase 1 — Product & Market:** what to sell, when, demand evidence, margin math. - **Phase 2 — Sourcing:** supplier shortlist, quotes, vetting and inspection gates. - **Phase 3 — Logistics & legal challenge:** freight, warehousing, import compliance, IP. - **Phase 4 — Launch & scale:** listings, PPC, storefront, design sign-off. ```mermaid flowchart TD P0["Phase 0 — Prompt perfection + Wizard briefing
(no seat speaks before the dossier lands)"] --> P1["Phase 1 — Product & Market"] P1 --> P2["Phase 2 — Sourcing"] P2 --> P3["Phase 3 — Logistics & Legal Challenge"] P3 --> P4["Phase 4 — Launch & Scale"] P4 --> V["Mercer synthesizes:
GO / GO WITH CONDITIONS / BLOCKED"] P4 -.->|"phase regression
(max 3, then escalate)"| P0 ``` **Live discussion** — seats don't file reports, they debate each other through Mercer: positions, rebuttals, concessions, max 3 rounds per question, then the gavel. Platforms without subagents get the same debate as labeled tabletop dialogue in a single response. **Phase regression** — phases aren't one-way. A finding that invalidates earlier output loops the request back to that phase (max 3 regressions per request, then Mercer escalates or terminates). **"Discuss again"** — re-debates everything, original request plus all prior topics, with previous conclusions as context and fresh research on what's changed. New verdict references the prior decision. No new information, no theater — Mercer recommends instead. **Mercer decides** — he monitors every phase gate with full operational power: advance, loop back, re-scope, pause, escalate, terminate. Money, production deploys, and external commitments still need your explicit approval. **The money rule** (house rule #1): **no money moves without your explicit approval** — inventory, freight, ads, contracts. Every buy ships with Finance Counsel's landed-cost model. **Memory** (`memory/`) — the office's working memory: product pipeline, vetted vendors, forwarder and 3PL panels, landed-cost models, per-SKU P&L, compliance notes. See [Privacy](#-privacy--read-before-you-commit) — vendor names, rates, and margins live here. **Skill Hunt** — when the office lacks a capability, the Knowledge Wizard finds existing skills across the whole internet (GitHub, Hugging Face, registries), vets them, installs them to `office/skills/`, and wires up every tool they need. See `office/playbooks/skill-hunt.md`. ## Getting started — connect it to your system Since this is open source, a new user needs a few minutes of setup before their AI agent can run the office. Three paths: ### What you need - An AI agent that can read files and spawn subagents (Muse, ChatGPT, Claude, or any agentic coding assistant). Agents without subagents (e.g. Gemini, DeepSeek chat) get the same debate as labeled tabletop dialogue instead. - `git` — only if you want the local-integration path below. ### Option A — trigger phrase (30 seconds, zero setup) Paste the activation phrase from [above](#-activate-this-office) into any AI agent. It fetches this repo, loads the office bundle (`office/AGENTS.md`), becomes Mercer, and confirms activation. Nothing to install. ### Option B — local integration (recommended for daily use) 1. **Clone the repo:** `git clone https://github.com/nx9161/seller-protocol && cd seller-protocol` 2. **Give your agent the office.** Either: - Open the clone as your agent's working directory, or - Drop `office/AGENTS.md` into your own project root — it's the comp

# dsh-permit-report-check — Administrative licensing application register completeness and date consistency check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-permit-report-check` reads one 行政许可办理台账 — the applicant header plus one row per application item — and checks that register's own closed loop and internal consistency: that each item listed in the 申请材料 column records whether it was submitted, that 受理日期 does not fall after 决定日期, that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and the 承诺办结日 the register itself records, that 决定结果 comes from the vocabulary you configured, that a record whose 决定结果 marks a grant carries its 许可证号, that the header names its 申请人 and 申请事项, and that no 许可事项 is registered twice in the table.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-permit-report-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-permit-report-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-permit-report-check: real output over its PR-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permit-report-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-permit-report-check-hero.png)

![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permit-report-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permit-report-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-permit-report-check-demo.gif)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PR-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row lists materials in 申请材料, but 已提交材料 is blank — is that reported? | Yes. `PR-001` requires a `submittedItems` value on every row whose 申请材料 cell is filled, and reports the row when the submission column is empty. It reads the register's own materials column and checks only whether the submission is recorded: it does not compare that list with the matter's service guide, and does not judge whether the materials submitted are complete or compliant. If no row has a filled 申请材料 cell, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| 受理日期 is later than 决定日期 — will that be caught? | Yes. `PR-002` compares the two dates the register itself carries, `acceptedAt` against `decidedAt`, treats the same day as not later, and reports the row where acceptance follows the decision. It only compares those two dates: it does not judge whether the acceptance was lawful or whether the application should have been accepted. A date it cannot parse is reported as its own finding rather than skipped silently. |
| What happens when the 承诺办结日 column is empty — and is the 法定时限 column checked at all? | `PR-003` reports itself in `skipped`: no day count is built in, because statutory periods are counted in working days, may be extended and may exclude hearing or expert-review time, so the only baseline is the 承诺办结日 (`dueAt`) the register states. No rule reads the 法定时限 (`legalDays`) column. When `dueAt` is filled, the rule checks that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and it; a finding means the decision disagrees with the deadline you recorded, never that it was late. |
| I wrote 补正后准予 into 决定结果. Is that accepted? | `PR-004` checks 决定结果 against the vocabulary in its `values` parameter, and that parameter ships empty — so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of judging your wording. Fill `values` with the outcomes your institution records (for example 不予受理) and any value not on that list is reported. The rule checks only whether the value is on the list; it does not judge whether the decision is correct or lawful. |
| A record says 准予 but the 许可证号 column is blank. | `PR-005` reports it: when 决定结果 matches a grant marker — `conditionValues`, by default 准予 / 准予许可 / 通过 / 同意 / 已办结 / 批准 — the record must carry its 许可证号 (`certificateNo`). It checks only that the number is filled in, not whether the certificate is genuine, valid or served. With no row matching a grant marker, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| The same 许可事项 appears in two rows. | `PR-007` reports the later row and names the row it duplicates, because two registrations of one matter make the deadline check ambiguous. It checks uniqueness only, and a hit needs human confirmation: one project applying for several matters may legitimately look the same, so distinguish it in the materials column rather than deleting the row. Differences in whitespace are ignored; with no 许可事项 column the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 | 现行版本与条号本次未核实 | PR-001, PR-002, PR-005, PR-006, PR-007 |
| 各事项办事指南与承诺时限（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为台账写明的承诺办结日）—— ⚠️ 法定上限见《行政许可法》第四十二条，本条不引用该条 | PR-003 |
| 本机构许可办理管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的结果口径）—— ⚠️ 法定决定类型见《行政许可法》第三十八条，本条不引用该条 | PR-004 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **行政许可办理台账** for the closed loop a register can be held to — that each
application item records its submission, that acceptance does not follow the decision, that the decision falls
between acceptance and the promised completion date, that the decision outcome comes from your vocabulary, that a
grant records its certificate number, that the register names its applicant and matter, and that matters are not
double-registered. It does **not** decide whether a permit decision was lawful, whether the materials were
complete or compliant, whether an application should be accepted, or whether a permit should be granted.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not judge
>
> **It does not check whether the materials list is complete.** It reads the register's **own** 申请材料 column
> and checks that each listed item records whether it was submitted — **not** whether that list matches the
> matter's service guide. Verifying the list means comparing it against the guide, which this plugin does not do.
>
> **No statutory period is built in — and the statute says why that is the right call.**
> 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》was read verbatim (see `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md`), and three of its
> provisions make a built-in number unusable: **article 82 requires statutory periods to be counted in working
> days, excluding public holidays**; article 42 sets twenty days with a ten-day extension (forty-five plus
> fifteen for joint handling); and article 45 excludes time needed for hearings, testing, inspection and expert
> review from the period altogether. A register normally records calendar dates, so `PR-003` compares the decision
> date against the **promised completion date written in the register**, and reports itself in `skipped` when that
> column is empty. A finding means "this disagrees with the deadline you recorded", never "this was late".
>
> ⚠️ **The text read was the 2003 promulgation**; a 2019 amendment exists and **was not obtained**, so the pack
> keeps the note 「现行版本与条号本次未核实」 on every rule and claims no article is current law.
>
> **The outcome vocabulary ships empty.** Wording for grants, refusals and terminations varies by institution
> and matter, so `PR-004` reports itself in `skipped` until you configure it, and `PR-005` (which requires a
> certificate number once a grant is recorded) uses a configurable set of grant marker values rather than a
> built-in list.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The
> regime lives in 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 and in each matter's service guide. The verification pass could
> not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every
> rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and
> raise `kind` to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=2
